svg.title: Case file: Dhruv Puri
svg.desc: An investigation board. Index cards for the subject Dhruv Puri, exhibits for Raktara, Chatgpt-token-counter, Deox, Sekku, Knowmon and PredictaStock-AI, a witness statement from the ADP internship, a field report from GSSoC 2026, hackathons, a wanted poster for AI/ML and software engineering roles, and a note of tools, all pinned to a wall and joined by red thread with small pulses of evidence travelling along them.
